description: S3 static-website module: encryption, versioning, lifecycle, public-access controls, CORS, required tags

assertions: Server-side encryption (AES256) is always enabled with no variable to disable it
A lifecycle rule transitions objects to Glacier after 90 days
All public access is blocked by default and only configurable for website hosting
Website configuration exposes index and error documents
Environment, Owner, and CostCenter tags are required (validated) inputs
Module ships .tftest.hcl tests covering the security defaults
